title: This Boston Dynamics robot is getting smarter every day 👀 #trendingshorts #ai #robot #tech
description:
Boston Dynamics has integrated Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 model into its quadruped robot Spot, bringing embodied reasoning to thousands of industrial facilities worldwide.

The upgrade enables Spot to autonomously read complex instruments, detect hazards, and determine whether tasks have succeeded or failed using multi-camera reasoning.

The model combines spatial understanding with code execution to interpret gauges, sight glasses, and other non-instrumented equipment that lacks its own sensors.

Boston Dynamics remains one of the few companies commercially deploying AI-powered legged robots at scale, giving it a unique advantage: real-world operational data from paying customers that continuously improves the system's intelligence.

The model is also now publicly available on Google AI Studio.
